item.title: Trying To Connect Real And Digital Worlds: MoneyGram CEO
item.description: Anthony Soohoo, CEO of MoneyGram, joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Kalshi's $40B Valuation Is 'Staggering': Yesha Yadav
item.description: Yesha Yadav, professor of law and associate dean at Vanderbilt Law School joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss the growth of prediction markets, regulation, and Kalshi's $40 billion valuation. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bitcoin Whales Add 43,000 Bitcoin in 60 Days
item.description: Bitcoin whales have added about 43,000 Bitcoin over the past 60 days, worth roughly $2.75 billion at current prices, according to CryptoQuant. Kavita Gupta, founder & general partner of the Delta Blockchain Fund, says she sees a movement of Bitcoin, rather than buying of Bitcoin. She joins "Bloomberg Crypto." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Expect Volatility In Results: Securitize CEO
item.description: Carlos Domingo, CEO & co-founder Securitize, joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss Securitize's launch of the Neuberger Securitize High Income Tokenized Fund ("HINC") and the company's recently announced earnings. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: FalconX CEO Talks Deals, Potential IPO, Layoffs
item.description: Raghu Yarlagadda, CEO FalconX, joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." Digital assets brokerage firm FalconX has cut 10% of staff globally, as it prepares for a prolonged downturn in cryptocurrency markets, according to people familiar with the matter. FalconX has facilitated about $2.5 trillion in trading volume. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Silicon Valley Is Still the Center of AI, Says GV
item.description: The speed of AI development means investors trying to stay ahead of the curve, need to move faster than ever. For venture firm GV, this means focusing on the application layer, having already made strategic bets on AI infrastructure and chip startups. Dave Munichiello, managing partner at GV, discusses GV’s early investment in Modular and its acquisition by Qualcomm, and why the firm is encouraging investors to spend more time in Silicon Valley. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Stress Tester: Models Have Crossed a ‘Threshold of Competency’
item.description: After AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic and others broke out of controlled tests and accessed real-world systems, new questions were raised about how they should be assessed before deployment. Those evaluations were run with Irregular, a startup hired to stress-test advanced AI models. But the sandboxed environment had a critical flaw: a misconfiguration meant the models could access the open internet. Dan Lahav, CEO of Irregular, explains how a human error left one testing environment connected to the internet, and what the industry is changing to make safety evaluations more secure. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Anthropic’s $65 Billion Surge, OpenAI’s Teen Push | Bloomberg Tech 8/18/2026
item.description: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down Anthropic’s annualized revenue topping $65 billion as the AI startup moves closer to a potential IPO. Plus, OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens, aimed at giving 13- to 17-year-olds a safer way to use the chatbot for learning. And, after advanced AI models escaped controlled safety tests and accessed real-world systems, we speak with the CEO of the startup hired to stress-test them. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: ChatGPT Shouldn’t Be a ‘Friend’ to Teens, Says OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI is releasing ChatGPT for Teens, a version of its AI chatbot aimed at children aged 13 to 17 that the company says encourages safe usage and deeper learning. The model includes features such as Study Mode, quiet hours, and reminders to take a break. Lauren Jonas, OpenAI's head of youth and families, joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Anthropic’s Revenue Boom Builds Ahead of IPO
item.description: Anthropic is on track to generate annualized revenue of more than $65 billion based on its current performance, up more than sevenfold from its pace at the end of last year. Bloomberg's Shirin Ghaffary explains what this means as the AI company gets ready to make its Wall Street debut. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro to Limit New Data Centers
item.description: Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro ordered strict new guardrails on data centers in the state, joining a rush of states pushing back against soaring corporate investment fueled by the development of artificial intelligence.
item.dc:creator: Liz Skalka

item.title: TikTok Is Exploring Feature to Send Money Over Direct Messages
item.description: TikTok is exploring a feature that would allow users to send money to each other in direct messages, in a move that would extend the social media app’s push into financial services.
item.dc:creator: Natalie Lung and Alexandra S. Levine

item.title: OpenAI Makes AI Safety Changes in Wake of Hugging Face Breach
item.description: OpenAI said it’s implementing more aggressive systems to monitor and safeguard artificial intelligence models under development after recent cybersecurity incidents ignited concerns about AI tools running amok.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Metz

item.title: Meta Exploits Kids on Social Media, States Allege at Trial
item.description: Meta Platforms Inc. has deceived the public for years by targeting children on Facebook and Instagram with technology designed to turn them into compulsive users and drive up advertising revenue, a lawyer at the California attorney general’s office told a jury.
item.dc:creator: Madlin Mekelburg and Isaiah Poritz (Bloomberg Law)

item.title: Home Depot Results Beat Estimates, Overcoming Housing Slump
item.description: Home Depot Inc.’s results beat estimates in the latest quarter, a sign that spending on improvement projects is holding up despite high borrowing and housing costs. Bloomberg's Lindsay Dutch joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Anthropic’s Annualized Revenue Tops $65 Billion Before IPO
item.description: Anthropic PBC is on track to generate annualized revenue of more than $65 billion based on its current performance, according to people familiar with the matter, up more than sevenfold from its pace at the end of last year. Bloomberg's Mandeep Singh joins Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: French Tax Office to Use AI to Probe Vulnerabilities After Hack
item.description: The French tax office is planning to use artificial intelligence tools to probe for weaknesses after it was targeted by a cyberattack that exposed personal details of hundreds of thousands of taxpayers.
item.dc:creator: Ania Nussbaum and Benoit Berthelot

item.title: Anthropic Pre-IPO Credit Facility Set to Climb Past $10 Billion
item.description: Anthropic PBC’s revolving credit facility is set to rise above its roughly $10 billion target, according to people familiar with the matter, as the artificial intelligence firm prepares for a highly anticipated initial public offering.
item.dc:creator: Bailey Lipschultz and Sridhar Natarajan

item.title: Thoma Bravo Weighs Concessions in $2 Billion Sophos Refinancing
item.description: Thoma Bravo-backed software firm Sophos is focusing on existing lenders to refinance or extend more than $2 billion of loans as soon as next month, after efforts to secure private credit backing faltered, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reshmi Basu

item.title: JPMorgan’s Santos Says ‘AI Tentacle’ Risk Spans Bonds and Stocks
item.description: JPMorgan Asset Management’s Gabriela Santos warned that “AI-factor” concentration risk has spread beyond equities into fixed income, ratcheting up the need for investor caution even as the super-cycle thesis remains intact.
item.dc:creator: Dani Burger
